title: TradingAgents Run Manifest
description: Contract for the one run-scoped manifest written by every TradingAgents run. It records lifecycle state, identity, sanitized configuration, timing, measurement counters, data-source status, safety-gate result, and artifact hashes.

timing.description: Monotonic phase timing. started_at is before the startup manifest write; analysis starts after that write; publish covers report/final-state/memory and terminal manifest serialization/validation/fsync up to the final atomic replace. manifest_write_seconds ends before the final replace so it is known before the terminal file is written. duration_seconds is the sum of startup, analysis, and publish phases; external harness measurement includes the final replace.

counts.description: llm_calls includes analyst, debate, trader, risk, portfolio, structured-output retry, and reflection/settlement calls observed by the run callback boundary. tool_calls counts analyst tool callbacks. prefetch_calls counts direct data calls outside tool callbacks. retry_attempts and fallback_attempts are vendor-boundary counters and are not merged into the other counters.

tokens.description: Token totals over the LLM calls that reported usage. status=complete means every llm_call reported usage; partial means some did; unavailable means none did. Unknown values are null, never zero. llm_calls_with_usage plus llm_calls_without_usage equals counts.llm_calls.
